intent: Dashboard stays current after Update, terminal registration and restarts
notes: After Update, a Fleet row could keep showing the old version (#107). The page gave up waiting after 30 seconds without redrawing, and it could accept a scan that started before the Update finished. Fleet scans are now numbered: Refresh waits for the scan the server names, a Refresh during a running scan queues exactly one more instead of being dropped, and a failed scan still counts as finished, so nothing waits forever.

Every 10 seconds the page asks the server whether it has newer Fleet data and redraws Fleet when it does, but never under an open menu or dialog. A repository registered from a terminal therefore appears without a click, finishing the #108 fix. A scan that outlasts Refresh's wait also appears when it completes.

When the server was restarted with a different version, the page now shows "The Dashboard was restarted with a different version. Reload this page to use it." with a Reload button (#20). The server stamps every page with a build ID, a hash of the version and the Dashboard's page files.

`gator kill dashboard` without a choice no longer only lists processes, which led people to think a stale Dashboard was gone (#15). It now says "Nothing was stopped" and names `--all`, `--port <N>` and the new `--list`. The kill tests that run the real command now use `--dry-run`, so a test run can no longer stop a live Dashboard on port 8420 or 8429.

The release smoke installs now retry `pip install` 6 times, 20 seconds apart, because the index-update race still failed releases after the existing wait step (#77). The release procedure's manual rerun step is now the rare case.
